name: Wallachia
description: A white field bearing a black raven with a cross in its beak, perched on a green juniper branch.
history: Civil flag of the Principality of Wallachia in the 19th century, bearing the principality's bird-and-cross emblem. Wallachia united with Moldavia in 1859 to form Romania.

features.symbolism: the golden-cross bird of the Wallachian arms
